chat_summary: Sia is using WhatsApp Web on Microsoft Edge to communicate with her contact "Anuj College." She has sent messages like "I will call you soon" and "Hey bro, what's up?" but is experiencing visibility issues, stating, "I cannot view messages," which complicates chat selection. After refreshing WhatsApp Web, she was prompted to check her latest messages but still cannot see any. Sia also faces a typing issue in Hebrew, as she can only send messages. She is searching for contacts with phone numbers ending in "66" and "6655" for reliable messaging and recently received a number, "77109166." Sia has drafted a message to clarify which specific college "Anuj College" refers to and is preparing to send it. Anuj has offered assistance by letting Sia open his WhatsApp, but she noted that there is no open WhatsApp. She has asked for clarification on what Anuj would like to open and has set WhatsApp Web in Microsoft Edge as the default user. Open threads include confirming the visibility of resent messages, addressing the Hebrew typing issue, obtaining necessary contact information, clarifying the college associated with "Anuj College," and ensuring reliable messaging. Sia also inquired about the current Prime Minister of India.
